_comment: Compliance-claim denylist (ADR-1202, Constitution E3). Checked case-insensitively against the RENDERED bytes, never against the input value -- an input-side check is defeated by any encoding the renderer later undoes. Extending this list is a reviewed diff.

allowed_in_context._comment: Phrases that CONTAIN a denylisted token but are the honest negation of it. The lint matches these first and, on a match, does not fire for that occurrence. Each entry exists because the page needs to SAY the true thing, and a denylist with no escape hatch teaches authors to write vaguer sentences rather than truer ones.
phrases: we do not give legal advice
we cannot promise that any system is fully secure
